fieldData.main-content:
As the first season of Radix Rewards has now drawn to a close, we’ve been busy calculating everyone's points and share of the rewards pool. We’re ahead of schedule on this, which means we’re going to be kicking off the distribution shortly!

On February 3rd, 2026, at approximately 16:00 UTC, the vesting for Radix Rewards Season 0 and Season 1 goes live. This release represents a total pool of 114,347,194.845748 XRD, including the Season 0 bonus.

Following the community consultation, we have implemented a structured vesting schedule to ensure a stable transition for the ecosystem. The process is split into two steps:

  1. Claiming: You can claim 100% of your pool units to your wallet immediately. This is your total share of the reward pool.
  2. Redeeming: 20% of your XRD is available for immediate redemption and the remaining 80% vests linearly over a 7-day period.

‍

The Diamond Hands Bonus

If a participant decides to exit their position fully before the 7-day vest is complete, they don't just leave, they leave a "tip" to those who remain.

Redeeming your pool units before the vesting completes means your unvested XRD is distributed proportionally to those who remain in the pool. 

A Note on Privacy

In an open ledger environment, privacy is a choice. We advise that you claim your rewards across multiple accounts using non-equal percentages. Don't make it easy for observers to map your total holdings. Direct your units to separate accounts to maintain a clean, anonymous on-chain footprint.

Next Steps

The dashboard is ready. Connect your wallet, verify your units, and manage your redemption starting tomorrow at 16:00 UTC.

Access the Rewards Portal: https://incentives.radixdlt.com/
